_readme: The live logger's selection mode (spec 029): which rows a drag lifts, where they may
land, the positions a move shows before the server answers, copy and paste, range
select and select-all. Generated from selection.js's own answers (the web is the
reference); selection.test.js keeps the reasoning behind each rule.
Records are logstate's: session_instance_tune_id (an integer, or 'temp-...' for an
optimistic row), order_position, record_type, name, tune_id, tune_type, _temp.

_not_fixtured.matchesFilter: a one-line normName contains; selectableIds covers it
